beats.summary: Michael struggles with the decision to give David a client list that could harm a family business.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Dwight, what will happen to that family if I call David and give him this information?
Dwight: Its simple, David would use that information to destroy them.

beats.summary: Michael decides to call David and give him the client list despite his reservations.

evidence.snippet: Michael: You are right. I will call David and give him the customer list and I will give him all my info.
Michael: Just something I have to do first.

beats.summary: Dwight chases Michael to stop him from giving away the client list, but ultimately takes it from him.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Freeze, give me the list!
Dwight: Its over, Michael, its over.

beats.summary: Michael reflects on the bittersweet feeling of harming a family while impressing David Wallace.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Guess whose stock just went up, golden boy?
